answer: A ridge of corroborating attestations from independent peers must confirm the agent before it earns voting weight. Each agent must solve a unique cipher challenge bound to its identity, then post a bonded stake into a shared vault that is slashed on duplicate-claim detection. Creating fake identities then costs real stake plus sustained peer work, making sybil farms economically irrational. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
